title: Oxford Covid-19 Government Response Tracker (OxCGRT)
notes: also contains for indices to reflect gov response

title: ILO Global Care Policy Portal
notes: over 60 legal and statistical indicators on maternity protection, paternity leave, parental leave and other care leave and non-discrimination policies, as well as childcare and long-term care services in more than 180 countries

title: CoronaNet
notes: policy domains included are Business Restrictions, Health Monitoring, Health Resources, Mask Policies, School Restrictions, Social Distancing with a total of 190 countries

title: OECD COVID-19 Country Policy Tracker
notes: What are countries doing to contain the spread of the coronavirus? How are countries helping people, small businesses and the economy to weather the crisis? // separate gits and csv for diff. policy fields // csv-format

title: HIT-COVID
notes: tracks the implementation and relaxation of public health and social measures (PHSMs) taken by governments to slow transmission of SARS-COV-2 globally

title: CCSL
notes: tracks interventions implemented to mitigate the burden of COVID-19, but also to characterise the political, public health, and economic strategies of the governments // unsure if econ data relevant or comprehensive

title: UNDP Covid-19 Global Gender Response Tracker
topics: ['covid', 'covid economic policies', 'unpaid care work', 'female economic security']
notes: identifies policy measures that address women's economic security, unpaid care work, and violence against women and tracks women's participation in COVID-19 task forces // likely highly relevant

title: WHO/EU HSRM Health System Response Monitor
notes: how countries’ health systems responded to the pandemic between 2020 and early 2022. The Archive of individual country evidence is complemented by cross-country comparative Analyses

title: ISSA (ILO) Country Profiles Social Security
notes: highly useful to categorize countries, but not crisis specific // by country (link leading to 2nd page containing pdf) // cover national social security programmes established by statute that insure individuals against interruption or loss of earnings and/or costs resulting from old age, invalidity or death; sickness and maternity or paternity; work injury or occupational disease; unemployment; and child raising and household subsistence

title: NORMLEX (ILO) Information System on International Labour Standards
notes: likely limited use //  information on International Labour Standards (such as ratification information, reporting requirements, comments of the ILO's supervisory bodies, etc.) as well as national labour and social security laws // list of  countries (link leading to 2nd page (country) linking to several third pages, i.e. of conventions)

title: NATLEX (ILO) Database of National Labor, Social security legislations
notes: likely better use than NORMLEX // full texts or abstracts of legislation, with links to the sources of information // multi-lingual // drop-down tool with links to links // limit to drop-down cat.: 'Labour codes, general labour and employment acts'

title: LEGOSH (ILO) Database Occupational Safety and Health
topics: ['safety and health at work', 'ohs inspections', "workers' rights"]
notes: no longer updated // no data on Covid

title: EPLex (ILO) Database Employment Protection
topics: ['termination of employment convention', 'employment protection', 'employer initiated dismissal']
notes: legal coverage of employment protection, regulations of the use of fixed-term contracts, regulations of probationary (trial) periods of regular (indefinite duration) contracts, valid and prohibited grounds for dismissal, categories of workers with special protection against dismissal, procedures for individual and for collective dismissals, redundancy and severance pay

title: IRLEX (ILO) Legal Database on Industrial Relations
notes: accessible summaries and legal texts on industrial relations across ILO member States

title: CEELEX (ILO) Database Central and Eastern European Labour Legistlation
topics: ['labour rights', 'industrial relations', 'trade unions', 'systematic provisions for ir']
notes: fundamental labour rights, such as freedom of association and collective bargaining, to working conditions (e.g. minimum wages, working hours), termination of employment contracts, labour dispute resolution, and regulation of non-standard forms of employment

title: LPHub (ILO) Labor Provisions in Trade Agreements Hub
notes: text of labour provisions in more than 100 bi- and pluri-lateral regional trade agreements, which engage about 140 economies // classification of labour provisions into categories

title: EURlex - Query on Covid Social and Employment legislation
notes: can be downloaded/requested as .csv set of all policies or opened individually as pdf or html // filter by EU institution or type of document // QUERY: CM~'covid19' AND (DC_CODED='5974' OR '35182' OR CT_CODED= 'SOCI' OR 'EMPL' OR CC='0520') ORDER BY XC DESC

title: EURlex - Query on 'financial crisis'
notes: can be downloaded/requested as .csv set of all policies or opened individually as pdf or html // filter by EU institution or type of document // QUERY: 'financial crisis' // query needs refinement

title: Covid Policy Tracker MENA
notes: unclear, if a dataset can be downloaded // journal article available // 12 Middle Eastern and North African countries: Algeria, Egypt, Jordan, Lebanon, Morocco, Tunisia, and the six Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) states (Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, the UAE)

title: API Deutscher Bundestag
notes: all law proposals and prints, protocolls, etc. notated by Vorgang (for follow-upwhat happened to law in Bundesrat etc) and including permanent links // results in json or xml

title: API Legifrance
notes: official gov API // API via the PISTE portal // freely accessible, but requires registration // link may change when API test tool updated

title: API Legislation UK
notes: official gov API // see more: https://legislation.github.io/data-documentation/api/overview.html  /// API runs under same url as browser interface

title: Legislation Archive Netherlands
notes: API only for metadata on all available datasets, but not on comprehens. fulltext legislation: https://data.overheid.nl/en/ondersteuning/data-publiceren/api // legis publications in Dutch

title: World Bank Group Global Database on Social Protection Responses to COVID-19
notes: a total of 3,856 social protection and labor measures  planned or implemented by 223 economies; contains details and categorizes; highly recommended by Lukas Lehner; csv-format

title: Liberalization Data Set (Armingeon/Baccaro)
notes: covers 37 advanced capitalist democracies between 1973 and 2013 and identifies a total of 12,426 reform policy changes (i.e., policy discontinuities) in 13 policy fields

title: EU Commission LABREF Labour Market Reform Database
topics: ['labour law', 'unemployment', 'short time working scheme', 'social assitance', 'employment subsidies', 'direct job creation schemes', 'job protection', 'statutory minima']
notes: records labour market and welfare policy measures introduced by the EU Member States // organised into 49 policy fields and further grouped in nine broad policy domains// year, description, scope, direction// csv-format

title: WeSIS Global Dynamics of Social Policy
topics: ['social policies', 'national attributes', 'labour market', 'labour law', 'unemployment', 'family and gender policies', 'social assistance', 'policy legacies', 'social structure', 'economic factors']
notes: from 1980s ongoing // 1. the introduction of state social policies, their generosity, inclusiveness, development over time; 2. trans- and international (inter-)dependencies and linkages between entities; 3. national attributes (like policy legacies, social structure, econ/fin factors) // must select out of many indicators // highly recommended Lukas Lehner// csv-format

title: OUTWB Stockholm Uni Social Policy Indicators Database
notes: includes 41 countries covering the years 2001-2022// distinguishes between overall income replacement rates in out-of-work benefits and the distribution of income replacement across earnings categories // csv-format

title: SAMIP Stockholm Uni Social Policy Indicators Database
notes: includes 34 industrialzed welfare democracies and observations are for every year 1990-2019 // Standard social assistance benefits are most often intended to meet certain basic and regular needs except housing // benefit levels have been calculated for three typical households; a single person, a lone parent, and a two parent family // csv-format

title: SCIP Stockholm Uni Social Policy Indicators Database
notes: discontinued and integrated into SIED, therefore nonfit

title: SIED Stockholm Uni Social Policy Indicators Database
notes: annual data for 37 countries from 2000 to 2023 //  Earlier versions of SIED cover five-year intervals from 1930–2020 // five major programs, including old age pensions and benefits in cases of sickness, unemployment and work accidents

title: Eurofound EU PolicyWatch
notes: does not include fin crisis 2008, but recent inflation // collates information on the responses of government and social partners to the COVID-19 crisis, the war in Ukraine, rising inflation, aimed at mitigating the social and economic impacts // html-database, with hyperlinks to other htmls for specific policies (no direct download?)
